sample_unit: patients (internal validation cohort with preserved EF and analyzable ECGs)
models_evaluated: AI-derived visually interpretable 2-step ECG algorithm for ATTR-CA

links.outcome: AI ECG algorithm discrimination in internal versus external cohort from a different center
links.effect: Internal AUC 0.87 (sensitivity 83%, specificity 91%); external AUC 0.84 (sensitivity 89%, specificity 79%). Specificity was lower in the external cohort.
links.quote: In the external cohort, the area under the curve was 0.84 (95% CI, 0.76-0.92), with sensitivity 89% (95% CI, 78%-94%) and specificity 79% (95% CI, 63%-90%).

screen.reason: Multicenter external validation of an AI-derived ECG algorithm for detecting cardiac amyloidosis evaluated by independent observers, assessing diagnostic accuracy and prognostic implications without testing a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
